svg.title: Half-order balance in the full form defect
svg.desc: Order and norm diagram for SF5 through SF10. L plus raises the coefficient orders of F in M(s minus 1) by one half. The actual adjoint L star lowers those of H in M(s) by one half. Both balanced expressions are in M(k), k equals s minus one half, and map u to L2 with an Xk bound. A separate negative residual correction is bounded by the bare energy norm squared. This is a schematic operator diagram, not a Hamilton trajectory.
svg.text: Half-order balance in the full form defect
M(r): coefficients before one ordinary derivative have order r; the free term has order r + 1.
SF5: both expressions map u to L²
Each norm ≤ C Xₖ(u); |balanced pairing| ≤ C Xₖ(u)².
WF′(E_L) misses K; SF10 bounds the separate residual term by Cᵣ ‖u‖ᵥ².
k = s − ½; Q is elliptic on K; u in V and Qu in V; L* is the actual adjoint.
No ordinary normal derivative is moved across the boundary.
